# Komal Hira — Visual Artist

> Portfolio site for Komal Hira, a Lahore, Pakistan-based visual artist working in oil on canvas. Her paintings are abstract biomorphic assemblages of shapes and symbols, drawn from memory and feeling.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction, artist statement excerpt, selected works.
- [Gallery](/gallery/): Full collection of 23 original oil-on-canvas paintings with title, medium, dimensions, year, and collection info for each.
- [About](/about/): Full biography, artist statement, education (MFA Visual Arts, M.A Painting), skillset, professional experience, commissions, exhibition history since 2015, and workshops/certifications.
- [Contact](/contact/): Email and phone for commissions and exhibition inquiries.

## Facts

- Name: Komal Hira
- Role: Visual Artist
- Location: Lahore, Pakistan
- Medium: Oil on canvas, mixed media, calligraphy, mosaic
- Education: MFA Visual Arts (2022) and M.A Painting (2018), College of Art & Design, University of Punjab
- Contact: Komalrasheed44@gmail.com
